business_summary: Glottis Limited operates as a freight forwarding company in India. The company offers airport delivery and door-to-door delivery, express and priority cargo, freight consolidation, scheduled and charter flights, import and export customs clearance, end-to-end tracking, temperature-controlled air freight, dangerous goods handling, warehousing and distribution support, ecommerce air freight solutions and insurance coverage, reverse logistics support, and multimodal connectivity; and LCL and FCL shipping, break bulk cargo handling, customs clearing and write-ups, port-to-door delivery and door-to-door delivery, marine cargo insurance, cross-trade shipping, vessel chartering, temperature-controlled shipping, real-time tracking, and warehousing and CFS services. It also provides breakbulk cargo handling, vessel chartering, and personalized breakbulk chartering solutions, as well as oversized, heavy lift, and drayage services; smart locations and facilities, inventory control, added services, cross-docking and transloading, order fulfillment for e-commerce, customs-approved warehousing, warehousing choices, reverse logistics, and supply chain solutions; and truckload, less than load, and cargo consolidation services. In addition, the company offers origin-to-destination delivery, time-critical and priority cargo, freight consolidation, temperature-controlled logistics, warehousing and distribution solutions, and cargo insurance coverage; voyage planning and flawless execution, paperwork support, cargo handling solutions, deep cargo protection and insurance; goods classification, clear duty and tax guidance, expedited customs processing, staying current with regulations, and cargo support services; and vessel chartering services, such as custom trips and time options, handling for special cargo, ship operations and management, paperwork and rules, and protects cargo and investment. Glottis Limited was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Chennai, India.
